raw_sections.experience:
Professional Experience




Strategic Business Analyst | Product Owner| Scrum Master with 12+ years of IT experience, including 8+ years in Business Analysis and Agile Delivery, delivering Digital Transformation, Product Management, Enterprise Integration, Cloud Transformation, and AI-enabled solutions across EdTech, Academic Operations, Banking, Payments, Wealth Management, Insurance, P&C, Superannuation, Investments, and HR/Payroll for global clients across the UK, USA, Singapore, ANZ, Europe, China, and UAE. Led 15-member cross-functional Agile teams, improving team velocity (Focus Factor 50% → 80%) and accelerating delivery timelines by 10–15% through process optimization, backlog prioritization, and continuous improvement. Proven expertise in managing end-to-end product delivery, from discovery, requirements elicitation, and solution design through Agile delivery, UAT, implementation, production support and release management Expert in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, gap analysis, process re- engineering, backlog management, and creating BRDs, FRDs/FSDs, Epics, Features, User Stories, Acceptance Criteria, Process Flows, Functional Specifications and implementation roadmaps.


Strong Insurance domain expertise with hands-on experience in Sonata/Guidewire PolicyCenter, exposure to BillingCenter, Policy Administration, Reinsurance and Claim Center, supporting policy administration, implementation, enhancements, regulatory initiatives, and compliance-driven transformation programs. Experienced in Guidewire InsuranceNow Cloud implementation, delivering requirements, functional design, integrations, UAT, and end-to-end insurance platform transformation initiatives.
Hands-on experience delivering enterprise solutions across the Salesforce Ecosystem (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, CPQ, Agentforce), Mendix, Mulesoft, ServiceNow, Sonata / Guidewire PolicyCenter, Boomi, APIs, Microservices, Workflow Platforms, Cloud Applications, ETL, ERP, ITSM and Third-Party Integrations. Strong knowledge of Generative AI, Agentforce, Agentic AI, LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, AI Assistants, Workflow Automation, and Intelligent Automation, enabling AI-driven business solutions. Experience defining AI use cases, business rules, governance frameworks, adoption strategies, and success metrics to deliver AI-enabled business solutions. Experienced in managing international stakeholders and clients across BFSI, Wealth Management, Insurance, Payments, and enterprise transformation initiatives, with strong expertise in Small Commercial Lines and multi- vendor solution delivery.



Recognized for influencing global senior stakeholders, leading cross-functional teams, mitigating risks, and

delivering scalable, secure, business-critical solutions across global organizations. Strong understanding of the end-to-end insurance lifecycle, covering policy administration, underwriting, billing, claims, customer servicing, renewals, and policy closure.
